title: Hip-Hop Group Home Made Kazoku Returns from Ten-Year Hiatus
content: The official website of the hip-hop group Home Made Kazoku announced on Tuesday that they are returning after a ten-year hiatus. The group has re-signed with Sony's Ki/oon Music label.

title: 3 Anime Almost Done Adapting Their Source Material (& Likely to Stick the Landing)
content: Not every anime gets to adapt the entirety of its source material, but three series are so close to accomplishing that and doing it well. There are plenty of anime that get stuck in limbo or outright cancelled, preventing them from seeing the stories they’re based on through to the end.

title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Unveils Third Story Visual Featuring Knights Moralis
content: Witch Hat Atelier anime unveiled its third story visual which features Qiffrey’s apprentices and the Knights Moralis. The first story visual highlighted the dragon encounter from episode four, while the second story visual showcased scenes from episode six.

title: “Is This Magic?”: Spring 2026’s Magical Anime Amazes the Creator of the Most Modern Shonen Anime
content: Spring 2026’s magical anime , which has been mesmerizing fans with its beautiful animation and unique premise, has even moved the creator of one of modern shonen’s biggest series to share her admiration for it, perfectly capturing what this anime is all about.

title: Netflix Confirms New Anime Release Dates for May & June 2026 (Including Big Sequels)
content: Netflix is gearing up for a new Summer of anime releases that will not only include some brand new shows, but also streaming launches for some other returning franchises over the rest of the May and heading into June.

title: K Manga Adds Keepsake Heartache Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Wednesday that it has added Rin Mikimoto 's Keepsake Heartache ( Hōsekibako ni Ai wo Tsumeyō ) manga in English. Kodansha describes the story: At five, she started humming melodies. At ten, she found her treasure. At 14, her world lost its spark.

title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers Novels End in Next Novel
content: The 13th volume of Isle Osaki 's Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers ( Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kōryaku or Clear the world like a game with the zero believers goddess ) light novel series announced on April 20 that the series will end in the next volume.
